info.title: OpenWarp API
info.description: Public REST surface used by the SDKs and the Terraform provider. Authentication is a bearer session token, service token, or OAuth access token. All paths are relative to the instance origin. Advanced browser and protocol surfaces (OAuth authorization, MCP, SCIM, PKI) are intentionally not part of this contract.

post.description: Request device_id and new PEM CSR. Returns challenge_id, exact challenge text and expires_at. A proof must use the existing active certificate key, not the CSR key.

post.summary: Renew with a detached proof signed by the active certificate key
post.description: Request challenge_id and padded base64 detached signature of the exact returned challenge text. P256 ECDSA SHA256 or P384 ECDSA SHA384 ASN.1 DER, Ed25519, or RSA PKCS1 SHA256. Optional attestation JWT or tpm_evidence follows the current CA policy, with nonce equal to challenge_id. Replacement issuance and previous-certificate revocation commit atomically.
